change: Batched projections and causal attention, shared exact Hadamard rotations, symmetric packed decode, GPU greedy selection; FP16 boundaries and FP32 accumulators retained.
notes: Wall-clock throughput; two trials, four warmup steps, fixed 32 decode steps even after EOS. Kernel profiling disabled.
Context is allocated capacity, not active history. These trials do not benchmark a 256K active conversation.
Device allocation includes weights, cache capacity and workspace; not process RSS or total system memory.
No device allocations during measured prefill or decode. The 512-token batch increases activation workspace.
The independent logit oracle runs one token at a time. Greedy tokens must match and relative RMS error must remain below 1%; no tolerances were relaxed.
